title: Negative points and minor ownership issues
summary: This topic centers on scattered mentions of negative points, with clear examples touching on bad-weather grip, missing or nonworking items, audio quality, and some positive counterpoints about design and overall experience.

positive.summary: Positive reviews highlight a generally good driving experience and recommend the interior design around the monitor area despite mentioning negatives in passing.

negative.summary: The negative review specifically criticizes poor grip in bad weather.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention varied issues such as basic audio quality, a missing handbook, nonworking puddle lights, and unrelated route or future-purchase remarks, so examples are too fragmented for a single clear stance.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and several are too short or context-free to support a clear sentiment reading.
